L8·N3148unmasked layer
Fires within software/tech-documentation prose, peaking on the determiner "the" (and nearby tokens like "error", "user", "Gui") right before a named UI element, addon, or quoted error string — i.e. a determiner-before-technical-noun position rather than a semantic category; the same word types in list-like feature descriptions (often after commas) strongly suppress it.

L30·N4329unmasked layer
Fires on the token that *closes* an item inside a comma/slash-separated enumeration or technical spec (the final digit or unit word of a value, e.g. "4**8**", "6 **speed**", "A **squared**", "**Q**" in A,J,Q,K, "1**5**9"), while being strongly suppressed on connectives that instead continue such a sequence ("+", "and").
